default.description: Main window capabilities. Per rules/tauri-commands.md Permission Grant Shape, every non-`core:default` grant is either narrowed to a specific sub-permission or has an explicit justification: opener:allow-open-url scopes browser launches to URLs only (no Finder/Explorer reveal); dialog:allow-open scopes the Gemini Vertex SA picker (PR-G5) to read-only file pickers; autostart/updater/process are enumerated to the exact sub-permissions called by the renderer (no allow-install on updater, no allow-spawn on process). `log:default` was dropped 2026-05-06 — the renderer does not import @tauri-apps/api/log; the backend uses tauri-plugin-log via the Rust API which is independent of the IPC permission system. `core:tray:default` and `core:event:default` were dropped because they are already implicit sub-bundles of `core:default` — keeping the explicit lines was redundant. A follow-up (tracked separately) decomposes `core:default` into explicit sub-bundles to fully narrow event-emit and tray IPC; that audit is security-reviewer-led.
